description: Setup-owned subnet coordinates consumed by the sandbox gateway VMs.

gatewayCidrs.description:
Gateway ranges allowed by the sandbox subnet NSGs on TCP 3128. Deployments set up before
the admin port was removed from that rule also allow TCP 3129; both are accepted.

gatewayIps.description:
Static private IPs of the setup-created gateway VMs (one per replica). Setup releases
that predate the VMs leave this empty, and Internet sandboxes then refuse to start.

gatewaySubnetIds.description: Undelegated subnet reserved for the gateway replicas' static NICs.

sandboxCidrs.description: Sandbox source ranges allowed on the proxy listener.

sandboxCidrsByResource.description: Dedicated source ranges keyed by Sandbox resource id for exact linked-resource access.

sandboxSubnetIds.description: Dedicated delegated subnets whose sandboxes use the gateway.

vpcCidrs.description: Every VNet range excluded from gateway destinations.

workloadCidrs.description: Workload source ranges allowed on the authenticated admin listener.
